subtitles.awaken.ascent.rope_fire: A line of light is thrown
subtitles.awaken.ascent.vow_line: A line of light is given
awaken.ascent.remember.title: Your body remembers.
awaken.ascent.vow.how: Hold %s to throw the line. Let go to fly.
awaken.ascent.vow.waits: Its line waits for a %s-rank hunter.
awaken.ascent.vow.stir_door: The vault stirs. Its door will know you.
awaken.ascent.mastery.tether.gain: the line reaches further, the swing pumps harder
awaken.ascent.mastery.wings.gain: the wings slip through the air
awaken.ascent.gift.wings.how: In the air: jump, then jump again to open them.
awaken.ascent.core.dark: The core stays dark. It answers only to a climb up its rings.
awaken.ascent.core.rank: The core stirs, and stays dark. It waits for a %s-rank hunter.
awaken.ascent.gift.leap.how: In the air: jump again · sprint to dash · sneak high up to slam.
awaken.ascent.edge.leap.how: Jump. In the air, jump again.
awaken.ascent.trial.leaper.open: A gate is beating like a running heart: the Leaper's Gauntlet.
awaken.ascent.trial.skyborn.open: A gate opens onto open sky: the Sky Leviathan's trial.
awaken.ascent.gift.sky.how: Gliding, jump to fly · forward thrusts · sprint boosts · tap left or right twice to roll.
awaken.ascent.edge.sky.how: Open your wings, then jump again: fly.
awaken.ascent.gift.sovereign.how: Aether full, press %s: thirty seconds as the sky's own. Press it again high up: Judgement.
awaken.ascent.sovereign.aether: Not yet: the Aether must be full.
awaken.ascent.spire.built: The crown stays dark. It answers only to a line.
awaken.ascent.core.line: The core stays dark. It answers only to a line up its rings.
